name: scroll-storm
description: Scrolls the graph continuously with the wheel — 1200 events at 120Hz, then 600 back — so that frames are drawn without pause for long enough that draw p95 and p99 describe steady-state cost rather than first-frame warm-up. Every other scenario settles between steps and lets the app go idle, which is correct for what they measure and is why none of them produces enough draws for a tail percentile to mean anything. Scroll is also the only input here with no keyboard equivalent that goes through the same path, so this is what exercises it.
